about: Add planned workout context to the watch

## Goal
Fetch and cache today's planned STACK workout so the Garmin run field knows the intended training target.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Watch-safe API contract documented
- [ ] Scoped authentication designed
- [ ] Today payload fetches successfully
- [ ] Payload cached locally
- [ ] Target zone / pace shown in run field
- [ ] Offline fallback works
